summary: The team is in a critical push to finalize Asia Start videos and the September newsletter today while navigating an Outlook lockout, with the China Going-Global report and Intelligent China program marketing poised for the next phase.
summaryDetail: Right now, the most urgent issue is the Outlook account lockout affecting multiple devices; the team must delete and re-login on all devices, update the phone password, check the home computer, and contact JSB to confirm the backend lock is unlocked. In parallel, Joseph must share the final Asia Start videos today and fix the main video's mouth/voice sync, enlarge lower-third titles, and extend the closing slide, while also sending the September newsletter today and getting Li Wei's confirmation on the US Treasury article translation by COB Sunday. The knowledge website redesign is moving forward with Joseph to share his HTML design and a half-hour feedback meeting to be scheduled, focusing on menu categorization and integrating BCI/BSI indices. Looking ahead, the team must prioritize Asia Star and Intelligent China for SEO and marketing, draft an audit plan, clarify Google Ads conversion tracking, and analyze participant profiles; the 2026 WIL Forum agenda will be discussed at 11am today and again on Tuesday, and Alan Chen needs to confirm the rewritten Custom Program page copy and provide detailed Intelligent China program information in advance.

meetings.title: Knowledge Website Redesign Review
meetings.summary: The team reviewed the current knowledge website design and Joseph's alternative layout, agreeing that the menu categorization is the main improvement while most other elements remain similar. They discussed incorporating more articles and indices like BCI/BSI into the homepage, and planned a follow-up meeting to provide specific feedback.

meetings.title: CKGSB Global Marketing Strategy Meeting
meetings.summary: The team discussed prioritizing China-based programs (Asia Star and Intelligent China) for SEO and marketing, with a focus on understanding target audience and conversion tracking. They agreed to draft an audit plan and clarify Google Ads conversion setup.
